lineage.description: IPC acute food insecurity phase classifications were collected by FEWS NET field enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly) and spatially attributed to administrative units in Zimbabwe. The data represent current-situation scenario assessments for February, June, and October 2019, stored as GeoJSON/KML geographic files with IPC phase values and associated metadata. These classifications serve as a proxy impact metric for food insecurity driven by multiple hazards including drought.
